test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

If you work hard, you secure good marks.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The phrase "you secure" is inappropriate given the conditional clause "If you work hard."**
 
• The appropriate correction for** "you secure" **would be** "you will secure."**
 
• Conditional sentences often require a modal verb such as** "will"** for future certainty.
 
• The corrected sentence would be: **"If you work hard, you will secure good marks."**
 
• This correction ensures correct verb tense alignment and g**rammatical accuracy.**
 
• Using **"will secure"** makes the outcome of the condition **clear and grammatically correct.**

**Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Good marks** – This phrase is grammatically correct and does not need correction.
 
• **If you** – This phrase correctly introduces the conditional clause.
 
• **Work hard** – This phrase is also grammatically correct.
